request.prompt: Image 1 is a pixel-art avatar. Image 3 shows the person behind it, holding the avatar in front of his face. Image 2 shows the kind of mask to make: a rigid crumpled-paper pixel head mask. Create a character reference sheet of the person in image 3 wearing image 1 made into a mask like image 2. Character: an ordinary young man in a black hoodie; the mask is shaped and coloured exactly like the avatar in image 1, in crumpled paper like image 2. Lay it out as a clean grid of equal-size panels on one plain light grey background, one view per panel, no text, no labels.
